no_wind.example_text: Mino located the torn kite in the meadow. Mino said, “I would like to fly the kite.” Sammy said, “I could help you.” Using the tape, Sammy fixed the kite. Mino held the moon atlas. With the pencil, Mino sketched the moon on the paper.
